title: TOXIQ - Bad Old Days
htmlContent:
TOXIQ's contagious energy and ability to connect with his audience and fans have established his reputation for being one of the hottest hip-hop artists out there right now. TOXIC is back at it with his latest single titled "Bad Old Days." This hot new blooming single was shared with the public on 09 Sep 2022.

TOXIQ is always ready for a good time. His dedication to excellence and attention to musical detail is the factors of his music's success. The others are hard work and perseverance, factors that have opened more oversized doors than ever. TOXIQ in recent years.

TOXIQ "Bad Old Days" is now available for streaming on all music platforms.
